description: For progress payment, this log form records earned-value basis, percent complete, authorized changes, deductions, lien requirements, and forecast balance. Its supporting evidence includes quantity backup, site photos, delivery proof, stored-material inventory, payroll record, and inspection status.

blocks.guidance: Link this progress payment record to its evidence.
blocks.label: Progress Payment Record and Routing

blocks.guidance: Capture schedule of values, pay period, contract modifications, retainage, stored materials, and prior certificates for this progress payment.
blocks.label: Progress Payment Core Identifiers

blocks.guidance: For progress payment, explain certified amount, exception ledger, accounting handoff, updated continuation sheet, and payment record; transfer each progress payment open entry to the progress payment successor record and named owner.

blocks.guidance: Hold unsupported, duplicated, disputed, nonconforming, or contractually ineligible amounts for qualified review. Route unresolved progress payment work for review.

use_case: Use the log form during progress-payment application review when the progress payment record must identify schedule of values, pay period, contract modifications, retainage, stored materials, and prior certificates. Complete the applicable handoff for certified amount, exception ledger, accounting handoff, updated continuation sheet, and payment record.
